role: new independent species replication; selected among three structurally passing Phyllostomus datasets because it has the largest repeat-individual count (39)
biological_prediction: Cross-night individual identity should be expressed more strongly in place-conditioned vertical state than in a bat-wide marginal height distribution.

exclusions.deployment_manipulation: exclude reference deployments whose manipulation_type is present and not 'none'
exclusions.source_outliers: exclude explicit source outlier flags; if only visible exists, require visible=true

cohort.shifted_night_rule: timestamp minus 12 hours, then calendar date

horizontal.projection_rule: per admitted cohort, choose UTM zone from median x-y before numeric height is parsed

vertical.semantics: native GPS height above mean sea level; not AGL

probability_model.target_scoring: only target fixes whose horizontal cell is supported by both predictors

claim_boundary: vertical flight-use organization, not verified foraging
observational repeatability is not personality, learning or causation
sensitivities cannot override the primary 5-km result

required: more than half of evaluable individuals have positive conditional identity gain
conditional identity gain exceeds marginal identity gain
